snippet.title: Arcade Game: Professor Pac-Man (1983 Midway)
snippet.description:
A Trivia/Quiz game featuring Pac-Man as Professor. This game has several different fruit sub levels totaling 98 questions. After 99 questions, the game is automatically restarted back to question 1 again over and over again.

Note: No cheats were used. Had to use save states for this since this was a trivia/quiz game.
